title: Helwit Watermelon Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Watermelon Nicotine Pouches capture the mellow sweetness of ripe Watermelon in a clean, easy-to-enjoy format. The flavour is light and summery, delivering a gentle fruitiness that’s smooth on the senses without being overpowering. These slim, plant-based pouches provide discreet, mess-free nicotine delivery without smoke, vapour or odour. The 7mg strength is suitable for those seeking moderate nicotine satisfaction in a refreshingly fruity profile. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
